definitionEn: to mention or speak about somebody or something; to look at a source for information; or to send somebody or something to another person or place for help or a decision

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把（病人）转诊给专科医生（refer sb to sb）
uncommonMeanings.example: Our doctor referred him to a heart specialist. 我们的医生把他转诊给了心脏科专家。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把（争端、议案）提交给上级机构／法庭处理
uncommonMeanings.example: The bill was referred to a special committee. 该议案被提交给了一个专门委员会。

posExamples.sentence: The report refers to the silt problem of the Yellow River.
Please refer to page twelve for the irrigation data.
The village council referred the water dispute to the county government.

collocations.example: The writer refers to the Nile floods several times. 作者多次提到尼罗河泛滥。

collocations.phrase: refer to a dictionary / one's notes
collocations.example: He referred to three ancient maps before drawing a conclusion. 他查阅了三幅古地图才下结论。
In this report, "the valley" refers to the whole river basin. 本报告中“the valley”指的是整个流域。
The Yellow River is often referred to as China's Mother River. 黄河常被称为中国的母亲河。

collocations.translation: 把某人／某事转介、提交给……；让某人去参考……
collocations.example: Our teacher referred us to a website for the latest rainfall figures. 老师让我们上一个网站查最新降雨数据。
Refer back to the map on page three. 回头参看第3页上的地图。
He never referred to his rival by name. 他从未指名道姓提起对手。

wordForms.noun: reference 提及；参考；推荐信；referral 转诊，转介；referee 裁判员；（英式）证明人
wordForms.verb: refer（referred, referring；重读闭音节末尾单辅音，需双写 r）
wordForms.adjective: —（无常用形容词；名词 reference 可作定语：a reference book 参考书）
wordForms.other: 重音在第二音节 /rɪˈfɜː/，故 -ed/-ing 双写 r（referred / referring），但 reference /ˈrefrəns/ 重音前移，就不双写；refer to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，被动句里也不能丢：be referred to as ...。

classPractice.question: In the passage, "the Mother River" ________ (refer) to the Yellow River, not the Nile.
classPractice.note: 讲述文章内容用一般现在时，主语为单数第三人称，故用 refers；refer 后的介词 to 不可省略。

classPractice.question: 由数据指导的耕作常被称为“精准农业”。（be referred to as）
classPractice.answer: Farming guided by data is often referred to as "precision farming".
classPractice.note: refer to sth as sth 变被动后 to 必须保留：be referred to as；often 置于 be 动词之后。

translation: v. 使恢复精力，使凉爽提神；刷新，更新（页面、数据、显示）；续满，添加（饮料）；唤起（记忆）　n.（计算机／口语）刷新（这一动作）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to make someone feel less tired or less hot; to update the information shown on a screen or stored in a system.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 刷新，更新（屏幕上显示的信息或系统里的数据）
uncommonMeanings.example: Refresh the page and you will see today's soil moisture. 刷新页面就能看到今天的土壤湿度。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 唤起、提醒（某人的记忆），多用 refresh one's memory
uncommonMeanings.example: Let me refresh your memory about the Nile's yearly floods. 让我提醒你尼罗河每年泛滥的事。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 续满，添加（饮料）
uncommonMeanings.example: The waiter came round to refresh our glasses. 服务员过来给我们续杯。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （计算机／口语）刷新这一动作
uncommonMeanings.example: One more refresh and the water data will be up to date. 再刷新一次，用水数据就是最新的了。

posExamples.sentence: A cold drink by the canal refreshed the tired farmers.
The system refreshes the field data every fifteen minutes.
One quick refresh and the new irrigation plan appeared.

collocations.translation: 感到精神恢复，觉得神清气爽
collocations.example: After a nap he felt refreshed. 小睡之后他感到精神恢复了。
He refreshed himself with a cup of mint tea before going back to the fields. 他喝了杯薄荷茶提神，然后回到田里。
Refresh the page to load the newest water report. 刷新页面以加载最新的用水报告。

collocations.translation: 更新数据（取回最新数值）
collocations.example: Sensors refresh the data every hour. 传感器每小时更新一次数据。

collocations.translation: 唤起某人的记忆，提醒某人
collocations.example: These old photos refreshed my memory. 这些旧照片唤起了我的记忆。
Mint tea is a refreshing drink in summer. 薄荷茶是夏天提神解渴的饮料。
Drip irrigation is a refreshing change from flooding fields. 滴灌是对漫灌的一种令人耳目一新的改变。

collocations.translation: 进修课程，复习提高课程
collocations.example: The village ran a refresher course for young farmers. 村里为年轻农民办了一个进修班。

wordForms.noun: refreshment 提神，爽快；refreshments（复数）茶点，饮料｜refresher 进修课程，复习课
wordForms.adjective: refreshing 提神的；令人耳目一新的｜refreshed（人）恢复精力的
wordForms.adverb: refreshingly 令人耳目一新地（refreshingly honest 坦率得令人耳目一新）
wordForms.other: 构词 re-（再）+ fresh（新鲜的）→ 使重新新鲜。修饰人用 refreshed，修饰物、事用 refreshing；表示“茶点”时必须用复数 refreshments。

classPractice.question: After a short rest beside the Nile, the workers felt ______ (refresh) and went back to the fields.
classPractice.note: feel + 过去分词作表语，说明“人”恢复了精力；若填 refreshing 就变成“这些人令别人耳目一新”，主谓意义不符。

classPractice.question:
先刷新一下页面，屏幕就会显示每块田需要多少水。(refresh)
______ ______ ______ first, and the screen will show how much water each field needs.
classPractice.note: 祈使句 + and + 将来时，表示“先做A，就会B”；refresh 此处取“刷新（页面/数据）”义，是及物动词，直接跟宾语。

translation: v. 适合（某人的需要、条件、时间）；（衣服、颜色、发型）与……相配　n. 套装，西服；（特殊用途的）套服；（法律）诉讼；（纸牌的）一门花色
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to be convenient or right for someone; a set of clothes made from the same cloth.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （法律）诉讼，起诉（= lawsuit）
uncommonMeanings.example: Villagers brought a suit against the factory for polluting the river. 村民们对污染河流的工厂提起了诉讼。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （一副牌中的）一门花色；引申为“强项”（one's strong suit）
uncommonMeanings.example: Patience has never been his strong suit. 耐心从来不是他的强项。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （衣服、颜色）与某人相配、显得好看
uncommonMeanings.example: That dark green scarf really suits you. 那条墨绿色围巾很衬你。

posExamples.sentence: Drip irrigation suits dry areas where every drop counts.
Would Friday morning suit you for the visit to the farm?
He wore a grey suit to the conference on river management.

collocations.example: Any time after six suits me fine. 六点以后什么时候都行。
The silty soil is well suited to growing flax. 这种淤泥土很适合种亚麻。
The algorithm gives each field an amount of water that suits its needs. 算法给每块田一个满足其需要的水量。
Egypt built dams, and its neighbours soon followed suit. 埃及修了水坝，邻国很快也效仿了。
If you won't come, suit yourself. 你不来就随你便吧。

collocations.phrase: bring / file a suit against sb
collocations.example: They filed a suit against the water company. 他们把自来水公司告上了法庭。

collocations.translation: 适合各种口味／预算（广告常用）
collocations.example: The shop sells tools to suit all budgets. 这家店出售适合各种预算的工具。

wordForms.noun: suit 套装；诉讼｜suitability 适合（性）
wordForms.adjective: suitable 合适的（be suitable for）｜suited 适合的（be suited to/for）｜unsuitable 不合适的
wordForms.adverb: suitably 恰当地，合适地（suitably dressed）
wordForms.other: 辨析三兄弟：suit 指条件/时间/颜色“合适、相配”；fit 指尺寸“合身、装得下”；match 指颜色、款式“相配成套”。suit 作动词直接跟宾语，不能说 suit for；suitable 才用 for/to。

classPractice.question: The new watering plan ______ (suits / fits / matches) our small terraced farm perfectly.
classPractice.note: 此处说“方案在需求、条件上合适”，用 suit；fit 讲尺寸大小是否装得下、穿得下；match 讲颜色款式是否相配。

classPractice.question:
埃及修建了大坝，其他尼罗河沿岸国家很快也纷纷效仿。(suit)
Egypt built dams, and other Nile countries soon ______ ______.
classPractice.note: follow suit 原指打牌“跟出同一花色”，引申为“效仿、照着做”；此处与前句并列，用一般过去时 followed。

translation: v. （使）扩大，扩展，增加（数量、规模、范围）；（受热等）膨胀；扩展业务；详述，进一步阐述（expand on/upon）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to become greater in size, number or importance, or to make something greater.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 详述，进一步阐述（常用 expand on / upon sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Could you expand on your idea of smart irrigation? 你能进一步说说你的智慧灌溉设想吗？

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （金属、气体受热）膨胀
uncommonMeanings.example: Metal pipes expand when the desert sun heats them. 金属管道被沙漠阳光晒热时会膨胀。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （书面语，较少见）（人）放松下来，变得健谈
uncommonMeanings.example: After supper the old farmer expanded and told us about the canals. 晚饭后老农放松下来，跟我们讲起了那些水渠。

posExamples.sentence: Farmland along the Yellow River expanded quickly after the canals opened.
The company plans to expand its sensor business into Africa.
Please expand on how the algorithm decides each field's water.

collocations.example: The city expanded rapidly along the river. 这座城市沿河迅速扩张。

collocations.translation: 把业务/范围扩展到（新领域、新地区）
collocations.example: The firm expanded into precision farming. 这家公司把业务扩展到了精准农业。
The expert expanded on the water-saving plan. 专家进一步阐述了节水方案。
The team expanded the scope of the survey to three more villages. 团队把调查范围扩大到了另外三个村子。
Travelling along the Nile expanded her horizons. 沿尼罗河旅行开阔了她的眼界。
The steel gates expand and contract with the seasons. 钢闸门随季节热胀冷缩。
The mill expanded production after a good harvest. 丰收之后，磨坊扩大了生产。
Water-saving devices have an expanding market. 节水设备有着不断扩大的市场。

wordForms.noun: expansion 扩大，扩张，膨胀（the expansion of farmland）
wordForms.adjective: expansive 辽阔的；（人）健谈开朗的｜expandable 可扩展的
wordForms.adverb: expansively 广阔地；（说话）滔滔不绝地
wordForms.other: 反义词 contract（收缩）、shrink（缩小）。名词拼写是 expansion（-sion，不是 -tion）。搭配要分清：expand on 后面接“要讲的内容”，expand into 后面接“新领域或新地区”。

classPractice.question: The rapid ______ (expand) of farmland along the Yellow River raised grain output but used more water.
classPractice.note: 定冠词 the 与形容词 rapid 之后需要名词作主语，动词 expand 的名词形式是 expansion。

classPractice.question:
你能就“算法如何决定每块田的用水量”再详细讲一讲吗？(expand)
Could you ______ ______ how the algorithm decides how much water each field needs?
classPractice.note: “就某话题详述”用 expand on/upon sth；情态动词 could 之后用动词原形 expand。

translation: adj. 短时间内集中投入大量人力物力的，强化的；（农业）集约的，精耕细作的；（医疗）加强护理的；（构成合成词）大量消耗……的
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: involving a lot of work, effort or care in a short period of time; (of farming) using methods that get as much as possible out of a small area.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （农业）集约的，精耕细作的（与 extensive 粗放的相对）
uncommonMeanings.example: Intensive farming feeds millions from a narrow strip of land. 集约农业用一条狭长的土地养活了数百万人。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 构成合成词，表示“大量消耗（某种资源）的”，如 labour-intensive, water-intensive
uncommonMeanings.example: Rice is a water-intensive crop. 水稻是一种耗水量很大的作物。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （医疗）加强护理的，重症监护的（intensive care）
uncommonMeanings.example: He spent two nights in intensive care. 他在重症监护室待了两晚。

posExamples.sentence: Intensive farming along the Nile depends on careful irrigation.
She took an intensive four-week course in soil science.
Growing cotton is labour-intensive, so many hands are needed in the fields.

collocations.example: Intensive agriculture raises yields but exhausts the soil. 集约农业提高产量，却使地力耗竭。
The patient was moved to intensive care. 病人被转入重症监护室。
He signed up for an intensive English course. 他报了一个英语强化班。

collocations.translation: 精读（与 extensive reading 泛读相对）
collocations.example: Intensive reading means studying every sentence closely. 精读意味着逐句细读。
Hand-watering is labour-intensive. 人工浇水是劳动密集型的活儿。
Water-intensive crops are risky in dry regions. 在干旱地区种耗水作物很冒险。
Intensive use of fertilizer has polluted the river. 化肥的大量使用污染了河流。
They made an intensive study of the silt. 他们对泥沙做了深入研究。

wordForms.noun: intensity 强度，烈度｜intensification 加强，加剧
wordForms.adjective: intensive 集中投入的｜intense （程度）强烈的
wordForms.adverb: intensively 集中地，密集地｜intensely 强烈地
wordForms.other: 考点辨析：intense 说“程度强烈”（intense heat 酷热、intense pain 剧痛）；intensive 说“在短时间/小范围内集中投入”（intensive care、intensive farming）。农业上的反义是 extensive farming 粗放经营。

classPractice.question: Along the Nile, ______ (intense / intensive) farming supports a huge population on a very narrow strip of land.
classPractice.note: “集约农业”是固定说法 intensive farming，强调在小面积土地上集中投入；intense 表示“（程度）强烈的”，不能修饰 farming。

classPractice.question: Years of drought have ______ (intensive) the competition for river water.
classPractice.note: have 后需要动词的过去分词构成现在完成时；该词族的动词是 intensify，辅音字母 + y 结尾，变过去分词时 y 变 i 加 ed。

translation: adj. 空的，没有东西（人）的；空洞的，无意义的；（生活、内心）空虚的　v. 倒空，腾空；（人群）散去使某处空掉；（河流）注入，流入　n.（常用复数 empties）空瓶，空容器
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: containing nothing or nobody; to remove everything from a container or place.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （河流）注入，流入（empty into）
uncommonMeanings.example: The Yellow River empties into the Bohai Sea. 黄河注入渤海。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 空洞的，无实际意义的（话语、承诺、姿态）
uncommonMeanings.example: His promise to repair the canal proved empty. 他修渠的承诺原来是空话。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （内心）空虚的，若有所失的
uncommonMeanings.example: She felt empty after the whole village moved away. 全村人搬走后她感到很空虚。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （口语）空瓶、空罐、空容器（多用复数 empties）
uncommonMeanings.example: Put the empties by the door for collection. 把空瓶放到门边等人来收。

posExamples.sentence: By August the reservoir was almost empty.
He emptied the bucket of river water onto the young plants.
The truck collects the empties from the village shop weekly.

collocations.example: The Nile empties into the Mediterranean. 尼罗河注入地中海。
She emptied out the seed bag. 她把种子袋倒空了。
The room was emptied of furniture. 房间里的家具被搬空了。
Don't take this medicine on an empty stomach. 别空腹服用这种药。
Farmers are tired of empty promises. 农民们受够了空头承诺。
The old mill has stood empty for years. 那座老磨坊空置多年了。

collocations.translation: 空了一半的（half empty / half full 见悲观与乐观之别）
collocations.example: The tank was already half empty by noon. 中午时水箱已经空了一半。
They came back from the dry field empty-handed. 他们从干裂的田里空手而归。

wordForms.noun: emptiness 空虚，空旷｜empties 空瓶、空容器
wordForms.adjective: empty（比较级 emptier，最高级 emptiest）
wordForms.adverb: emptily 空洞地（用得很少，如 stare emptily 茫然地盯着）
wordForms.other: 辅音字母 + y 结尾，故第三人称单数 empties、过去式 emptied、比较级 emptier。合成词有 empty-handed 空手的、empty-headed 头脑空空的。注意 empty 说“容器/空间里没东西”，vacant 多指职位、座位、房间“空缺、无人占用”。

classPractice.question: The Yellow River ______ (empty) into the Bohai Sea, carrying tonnes of silt with it every year.
classPractice.note: 陈述客观事实用一般现在时，主语 The Yellow River 是第三人称单数，empty 变 empties；empty into 意为“（河流）注入”。

classPractice.question:
别再听那些空头承诺了；这个村子需要的是一套真正的灌溉系统。(empty)
Stop listening to those ______ ______; what the village needs is a real irrigation system.
classPractice.note: empty 在此取“空洞的、无实际内容的”义；those 后须接复数名词，故用 promises。

translation: v. 依靠，依赖；信赖，指望（总与 on / upon 连用）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to depend on someone or something in order to survive or work properly, or to trust them to do something.

posExamples.sentence: For centuries Egyptian farmers relied on the Nile's yearly flood.
Precision farming relies on sensors buried in the soil.
We rely on you to check the pumps every morning.

collocations.example: These villages rely on well water. 这些村子靠井水生活。
The region relies heavily on river water. 该地区严重依赖河水。

collocations.phrase: rely on sb to do sth
collocations.example: You can rely on him to fix the pump. 你可以指望他去修好水泵。

collocations.translation: 指望某人／某事发生（强调动作本身）
collocations.example: Don't rely on it raining next week. 别指望下周会下雨。

collocations.translation: 在某方面依靠某人／某物
collocations.example: The town relies on the dam for electricity. 这座城镇靠大坝供电。
Old records can't always be relied on. 旧记录未必总是靠得住。
Farmers once relied on guesswork to water crops. 农民曾经靠猜测来浇地。

wordForms.noun: reliance 依靠，依赖（reliance on sth）｜reliability 可靠性
wordForms.adjective: reliable 可靠的｜reliant 依赖的（be reliant on）｜unreliable 不可靠的
wordForms.adverb: reliably 可靠地（reliably informed 从可靠渠道获悉）
wordForms.other: rely 是不及物动词，后面必须跟 on/upon，不能说 rely sth。辅音字母 + y，故 relies / relied，但 -ing 前 y 不变，写作 relying。同义链：rely on = depend on = count on = be dependent on。

classPractice.question: Their heavy ______ (rely) on the yearly flood meant that one dry summer could ruin the harvest.
classPractice.note: 形容词 heavy 之后需要名词作主语，rely 的名词形式是 reliance，其后同样接 on/upon：reliance on sth。

classPractice.question:
如今农民不再靠猜测，而是依靠传感器来决定每块田需要多少水。(rely)
Today farmers no longer guess; they ______ ______ sensors to decide how much water each field needs.
classPractice.note: rely 是不及物动词，须借助 on/upon 才能带宾语；主语 they 是复数，一般现在时用原形 rely，构成 rely on sth to do sth。

translation: adj. 原始的，远古的，处于发展早期的；简陋的，落后的，不先进的；（生物）低等的　n.（艺术）文艺复兴前的早期画家或其作品（指“原始人”的用法今已少用，且可能冒犯）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: belonging to a very early stage of human or natural development; simple, old-fashioned and without modern comforts or technology.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 简陋的，条件很差的（不含“远古”意味，带贬义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The living conditions at the dam site were fairly primitive. 大坝工地上的居住条件相当简陋。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （生物）低等的，结构简单的
uncommonMeanings.example: Primitive life forms still survive in the salty lake. 低等生物仍在这个咸水湖里存活。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （艺术）文艺复兴前的早期画家，或其作品
uncommonMeanings.example: The gallery has a fine collection of Italian primitives. 这家美术馆收藏了不少意大利早期画作。

posExamples.sentence: Early Egyptians lifted river water with a primitive wooden device.
By today's standards, those irrigation ditches look primitive.
The gallery's collection of Italian primitives attracts visitors from across Europe.

collocations.example: They dug the channel with primitive tools. 他们用原始工具挖出了这条水渠。
In primitive society people farmed by the river. 在原始社会，人们沿河耕种。
The team worked in primitive conditions. 这支队伍在简陋的条件下工作。
Primitive irrigation methods wasted much water. 原始的灌溉方法浪费了大量水。
These hollow clay pipes were a primitive form of drainage. 这些中空的陶管是排水系统的一种早期雏形。
Primitive life forms appeared in ancient seas. 低等生物出现在远古海洋中。
Their storage methods remained primitive for centuries. 他们的储粮方法几百年来一直很落后。
Fear of flood is a primitive instinct. 对洪水的恐惧是一种原始本能。

wordForms.noun: primitive（艺术）早期画家及其作品｜primitiveness 原始状态，简陋
wordForms.adjective: primitive 原始的；简陋的
wordForms.other: 词根 prim- 表“第一、最早”：prime 首要的、primary 初级的、primitive 原始的。注意 primitive 侧重“技术水平低、条件简陋”，含贬义，不等于 ancient（年代久远，中性）或 old（旧的）。

classPractice.question: Before electric pumps arrived, villagers used a ______ (primitive / primary / prime) wooden lever to raise water from the river.
classPractice.note: 此处强调工具“原始、简陋、技术水平低”，用 primitive；primary 意为“首要的、初级的”，prime 意为“最重要的、最佳的”，都不表示“落后简陋”。

classPractice.question:
桔槔（一种木制杠杆）是现代水泵的一种早期雏形。(primitive)
The shadoof, a wooden lever, was ______ ______ ______ of the modern pump.
classPractice.note: a primitive form of sth 意为“某物的早期雏形”；此处作表语，可数名词 form 前须加不定冠词 a。

translation: v. 采用，采纳（方法、技术、名称）；采取（态度、姿态、口音）；收养，领养；正式通过，批准（决议、法案）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to start to use a new method, idea or attitude; also, to take another person's child into your family by law.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （会议、议会）正式通过，批准（决议、提案、预算）
uncommonMeanings.example: The council adopted the water-saving plan by a large majority. 委员会以多数票通过了节水方案。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 收养，领养（孩子）
uncommonMeanings.example: They adopted a boy whose village had been flooded. 他们收养了一个村子被淹没的男孩。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 采取（某种表情、语气、口音、姿态）
uncommonMeanings.example: He adopted a patient tone when explaining the algorithm. 他解释算法时采取了耐心的语气。

posExamples.sentence: More farms are adopting sensors that measure soil moisture.
Egypt adopted drip irrigation to save water in desert areas.
The meeting adopted a plan to protect the river's wetlands.

collocations.example: The village adopted a new watering method. 这个村子采用了一种新的浇水方法。

collocations.translation: 采取对待某事的方法（approach 后接介词 to）
collocations.example: Scientists adopted a data-based approach to farming. 科学家们采取了基于数据的耕作方法。
The government adopted a strict water policy. 政府采取了严格的用水政策。
Older farmers adopted a wait-and-see attitude. 年长的农民采取了观望态度。
The UN adopted a resolution on water safety. 联合国通过了一项水安全决议。
The couple adopted two children. 这对夫妇收养了两个孩子。
Drip irrigation is now widely adopted. 滴灌如今已被广泛采用。

wordForms.noun: adoption 采用；收养（the adoption of new technology）
wordForms.adjective: adopted 被收养的（an adopted daughter）｜adoptive 收养他人的（adoptive parents 养父母）
wordForms.other: 形近词三连辨析：adopt 采用、收养；adapt 使适应、改编（adapt to 适应）；adept 熟练的（be adept at）。另注意 adopted child 被收养的孩子 ≠ adoptive parents 养父母，两个形容词方向相反。

classPractice.question: Farmers who ______ (adopt / adapt) drip irrigation must also ______ (adopt / adapt) to a completely new way of thinking.
classPractice.note: adopt 意为“采用（新技术）”，及物直接跟宾语；adapt to 意为“适应（新事物）”，须与 to 连用。二者形近义异，是高频易混点。

classPractice.question: The wide ______ (adopt) of drip irrigation has cut water use on these farms by half.
classPractice.note: 定冠词 the 和形容词 wide 之后需要名词作主语，adopt 的名词形式是 adoption；该名词为单数，故谓语用 has cut。

translation: adj. 肥沃的，富饶的；（人、动物、植物）能生育的，能繁殖的；（头脑、想象力）丰富的，有创造力的
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: (of land or soil) able to produce good crops; (of people, animals or plants) able to produce young or seeds; (of a mind) producing many new ideas.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （卵、种子）已受精的，能孵化／发芽的（生物学用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: Only fertile eggs will hatch.

posExamples.sentence: The Nile floods each year and leaves a layer of fertile mud along its banks.
Silt from the Yellow River has made the northern plains unusually fertile.
Land that is watered but never rested slowly becomes less fertile.

collocations.translation: 肥沃的土壤／肥沃的土地
collocations.example: Fertile soil along the Nile fed Egypt for thousands of years. 尼罗河沿岸肥沃的土壤养活了埃及数千年。

collocations.translation: 使土壤肥沃／保持土壤肥力（keep + 宾语 + 形容词）
collocations.example: Algorithms decide the water amount and help keep the soil fertile. 算法决定水量，帮助保持土壤肥力。
Over-farming makes the fields grow less fertile every year. 过度耕种使田地一年比一年贫瘠。

collocations.translation: 肥沃的河谷／平原／三角洲（常与地形名词搭配）
collocations.example: The fertile valley below the dam produces two crops a year. 大坝下游肥沃的河谷一年两熟。

collocations.translation: …的沃土；有利于…发展的环境（比喻义）
collocations.example: Dry northern China has become fertile ground for precision farming. 干旱的中国北方成了精准农业发展的沃土。

collocations.translation: 丰富的想象力；思维活跃
collocations.example: The idea of algorithm-run irrigation came from a fertile imagination. 用算法管灌溉的想法出自丰富的想象力。

collocations.translation: 新月沃地（西亚两河流域一带的古代农业区）
collocations.example: The Fertile Crescent lay between two great rivers. 新月沃地位于两条大河之间。

wordForms.noun: fertility（肥沃；生育力，出生率）; fertilizer / fertiliser（肥料）; fertilization（施肥；受精）
wordForms.adjective: fertile（肥沃的），反义 infertile / barren（贫瘠的；不育的）
wordForms.other: 词族链：fertile → fertilize → fertilizer；-ile 是形容词后缀。英美读音差别大：英 /ˈfɜːtaɪl/，美 /ˈfɜːrtl/。修饰土地时 fertile 强调“出产多”，rich（in nutrients）强调“养分足”。

classPractice.question: The Nile's yearly floods left silt behind and made the valley one of the most ____ (fertility) regions on earth.
classPractice.note: one of the most 后需形容词最高级修饰名词 regions，故名词 fertility 转为形容词 fertile。

classPractice.question: 算法决定每块田需要多少水，这有助于农民保持土壤肥沃。（keep）
classPractice.answer: Algorithms decide how much water each field needs, which helps farmers keep the soil fertile.
classPractice.note: keep + 宾语 + 形容词作宾语补足语；how much water 引导宾语从句须用陈述语序。

translation: adv. 最终，最后（经过一系列过程之后）；归根结底，从根本上说（引出最重要的一点）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: in the end, after a long process; or used to say what is most important or basic about something.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 追根溯源，（起源上）最初来自（表来源而非时间先后，多与 come from / go back to 连用）
uncommonMeanings.example: The word ‘algorithm’ ultimately goes back to the name of a Persian mathematician.

posExamples.sentence: Smarter irrigation will ultimately save both water and money for farmers.
Ultimately, it is the algorithm, not the farmer, that decides the amount.
Years of over-pumping ultimately dried up half the wells in the valley.

collocations.example: Yields ultimately depend on how the water is used. 收成最终取决于水怎么用。
Flooding a field ultimately leads to salty, useless soil. 大水漫灌最终会导致土壤盐碱、无法耕种。
Each farmer is ultimately responsible for every drop used. 每个农民都要对用掉的每一滴水负最终责任。

collocations.phrase: the decision ultimately rests with sb
collocations.translation: 最终由某人决定（说了算）
collocations.example: The decision ultimately rests with the farmer, not the machine. 最终拍板的是农民，不是机器。
The trial cost a fortune, but it ultimately succeeded. 试验花费巨大，但最终成功了。

collocations.translation: 归根结底，说到底（评注整句，引出结论）
collocations.example: Ultimately, technology cannot create a single extra drop of water. 归根结底，技术造不出一滴多余的水。
What ultimately matters is how much water reaches the roots. 最终要紧的是有多少水到达根部。

wordForms.adjective: ultimate（最终的，最后的；根本的；最大的，极限的）
wordForms.noun: ultimatum（最后通牒，复数 ultimatums/ultimata）; the ultimate in sth（…的极品，最高境界）
wordForms.other: 位置规律：作句子副词时置于句首并用逗号隔开；修饰动词时置于实义动词前、be/助动词后。近义区别：eventually 侧重“经过很久终于”，finally 可用于列举末项，in the end 侧重“几经波折之后”，ultimately 还能表“从根本上说”，这一层是另外三个没有的。

classPractice.question: The system looks complicated, but it ____ (ultimate) makes irrigation much simpler for farmers.
classPractice.note: 空格修饰实义动词 makes，须用副词 ultimately；ultimate 是形容词，不能修饰动词。

classPractice.question: 用 ultimate / ultimately 填空：____, the ____ goal of precision farming is to grow more food with less water.
classPractice.note: 第一空为句首评注性副词 Ultimately（归根结底）；第二空修饰名词 goal，须用形容词 ultimate（最终的）。

translation: v. 释放，放走；排放，放出（气体、液体、热量等）；发布，公布；发行，上映（唱片、影片）  n. 释放；排放；发布，发行（物）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to let a person, animal or substance go free or escape; to make information, a film or a record available to the public; (n.) the act of doing this.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 松开（刹车、离合器、握着的手等）
uncommonMeanings.example: Release the brake slowly before the tractor moves.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 免除，解除（某人的职责、承诺），常用 release sb from sth
uncommonMeanings.example: The new system releases farmers from hours of manual watering.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （情绪上的）解脱，宣泄，如释重负
uncommonMeanings.example: Finishing the harvest brought a real sense of release.

posExamples.sentence: The dam releases water into the fields only when the sensors ask for it.
Wet soil releases greenhouse gases when it is ploughed too often.
The release of silt downstream has slowed since the dam was built.

collocations.example: Engineers release water from the reservoir twice a month. 工程师每月两次从水库放水。

collocations.phrase: release sth into the air / river
collocations.example: Factories once released waste into the Yellow River. 工厂曾把废水排进黄河。

collocations.phrase: release an animal (back) into the wild
collocations.example: The young fish were released back into the river. 这些鱼苗被放归河中。

collocations.translation: 发布报告；上映影片；发行专辑
collocations.example: The team released a report on water use last week. 该团队上周发布了一份用水报告。
The company sent out a press release about its new sensors. 公司就新型传感器发出了一份新闻稿。

collocations.phrase: the release of energy / heat / carbon
collocations.example: Ploughing speeds up the release of carbon from the soil. 耕地会加快土壤中碳的释放。
She released her grip on the rope. 她松开了抓着绳子的手。

collocations.translation: 使某人免于…，解除某人的（职责、承诺）
collocations.example: Automation releases farmers from the duty of watching every field. 自动化使农民不必再盯着每一块田。

wordForms.noun: release（释放；发行；解脱）——动名同形不变
wordForms.verb: release / released / released / releasing（规则变化）
wordForms.adjective: 无常用形容词；过去分词 released 可作定语（a newly released report 刚发布的报告）
wordForms.other: 辨析：release 指“放开使自由、排放、公开”；relieve 指“减轻（痛苦、压力）”；relax 指“放松”，三者不可互换。名词用法：a new release 新发行的影片／唱片；on general release 公映中。

classPractice.question: Water is ____ (release) from the reservoir only after the algorithm has worked out each field's needs.
classPractice.note: 空前已有系动词 is，主语 water 与 release 是动宾关系，故填过去分词 released，构成一般现在时的被动语态。

classPractice.question: 只有当传感器发出请求时，大坝才会向田里放水。Only when the sensors ask for it ____ ____ ____ water into the fields.
classPractice.note: only + 时间状语从句置于句首，主句用部分倒装：助动词 does 提前，实义动词用原形 release。

translation: n.（合同、协议的）条件，条款；措辞，说法；（人与人之间的）关系  【单数 term】术语；学期；期限，任期
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: the conditions that people agree to in a contract or deal; the words used to express something; also the relationship between people.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 分期付款条件（on easy terms 以分期付款方式）
uncommonMeanings.example: They bought the pump on easy terms.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【数学】项（等式或代数式中的一项）
uncommonMeanings.example: Move the last term to the other side of the equation.

posExamples.sentence: In terms of water use, drip irrigation easily beats flooding a whole field.
The two sides finally agreed on the terms of the water-sharing deal.
Farmers had to come to terms with a smaller share every year.

collocations.example: In terms of yield, the smart system is clearly ahead. 就产量而言，智能系统明显领先。

collocations.translation: 接受（不愉快的事实）；与…达成协议
collocations.example: Farmers must come to terms with less water each year. 农民必须接受每年水量减少的现实。

collocations.phrase: be on good / bad terms with sb
collocations.example: The two villages are on good terms over water. 两个村子在用水上关系融洽。

collocations.phrase: the terms of the contract / agreement
collocations.example: Under the terms of the agreement, each farm gets a fixed share. 根据协议条款，每个农场分得固定份额。

collocations.translation: 毫不含糊地，措辞强硬地
collocations.example: He told them in no uncertain terms to stop wasting water. 他毫不含糊地叫他们别再浪费水。

collocations.translation: 用简单的话说，通俗地讲
collocations.example: In simple terms, the algorithm counts every drop. 简单地说，这个算法在数每一滴水。
The government set the terms for using river water. 政府为使用河水定下了条件。
She wanted to farm on her own terms. 她想按自己的方式种地。

wordForms.noun: term（单数：术语；学期；任期；期限）/ terms（复数：条款；关系）
wordForms.verb: term（把…称为，常用被动 be termed）：This is termed precision farming.
wordForms.adjective: 复合形容词 long-term（长期的）/ short-term（短期的）/ mid-term（中期的），作定语时带连字符
wordForms.other: 两个易错点：① in terms of 后接名词或动名词（in terms of cost / in terms of saving water），也可接 how、what 引导的从句（in terms of how much water is used），但不能直接接 that 从句；② 副词短语用 in the long term（从长远看），形容词用 long-term（a long-term plan），不可混写。表“关系”和“条款”时 terms 必须用复数。

classPractice.question: In ____ (term) of water saving, drip irrigation is far ahead of the old flooding method.
classPractice.note: in terms of “就…而言”是固定搭配，term 在此恒用复数 terms，不可写成 in term of。

classPractice.question: 农民不得不接受每年可用水越来越少这个事实。Farmers have had to ____ ____ ____ ____ having less water every year.
classPractice.note: come to terms with sth 意为“接受（不快的事实）”，terms 用复数，with 为介词，后接名词或动名词 having。

translation: v. 下降，减少；衰退，衰落；婉言谢绝，拒绝  n. 下降，减少；衰退，衰亡
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to become smaller, weaker or fewer; to politely refuse an offer or invitation; (n.) a fall in number, amount or quality.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （地面）向下倾斜（较正式的书面用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The land declines gently towards the river.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【语法】（名词、代词、形容词）变格，作词形变化
uncommonMeanings.example: In Latin, nouns decline according to case.

posExamples.sentence: Water levels in the Yellow River decline sharply during the dry season.
There has been a steady decline in the amount of water each farm uses.
He politely declined the offer of a free sensor kit.

collocations.translation: …方面的下降／减少（用介词 in）
collocations.example: There has been a sharp decline in rainfall since 2015. 自2015年以来降雨量急剧减少。

collocations.translation: 下降了…（by 表变化幅度）
collocations.example: Water use declined by a quarter in three years. 三年里用水量下降了四分之一。

collocations.translation: 谢绝做某事（不用 decline doing）
collocations.example: The scientist declined to comment on the unfinished data. 那位科学家谢绝就未完成的数据发表意见。
She declined the invitation to the opening ceremony. 她婉拒了开幕式的邀请。

collocations.phrase: be in decline / fall into decline
collocations.example: Traditional flood irrigation is now in decline. 传统的大水漫灌正在没落。

collocations.translation: 急剧／持续／惊人地下降（常用修饰下降速度的副词）
collocations.example: Bee numbers have declined alarmingly since 2000. 自2000年以来蜂群数量减少得令人担忧。
New irrigation methods may reverse the decline in yields. 新的灌溉方式或许能扭转产量下滑。

collocations.translation: …的衰亡（用介词 of，接衰落的主体）
collocations.example: The decline of the ancient kingdom followed years of drought. 那个古王国的衰亡发生在多年干旱之后。

wordForms.noun: decline（下降；衰落）——动名同形
wordForms.verb: decline / declined / declined / declining（规则变化）
wordForms.adjective: declining（下降的，日渐衰退的）：a declining water table 不断下降的地下水位
wordForms.other: 介词搭配是考点：a decline in（下降的方面）、a decline of 5%（幅度）、the decline of（衰亡的主体）。同根词 incline（使倾斜；使倾向），名词 inclination。表“拒绝”时 decline 比 refuse 委婉正式，且只能 decline to do，不能 decline doing。

classPractice.question: The number of working wells in the valley has been ____ (decline) steadily since the river changed course.
classPractice.note: has been + doing 为现在完成进行时，强调下降持续至今；decline 在此为不及物动词，不用被动。

classPractice.question: 用 refuse / decline 的适当形式填空：The scientist politely ____ to comment, saying the data were not yet complete.
classPractice.note: politely 提示语气委婉，decline to do sth 表“礼貌谢绝”，正式而温和；refuse 语气强硬，与 politely 不搭。

translation: adv. 令人担忧地，惊人地（快、高、低到让人不安的程度），修饰动词或形容词
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: in a way that makes people worried or frightened, often because a change is too big or too fast.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【句子副词】令人担忧的是（置于句首并用逗号隔开，评论整句内容，而非修饰某个动词）
uncommonMeanings.example: Alarmingly, half of the wells have already run dry.

posExamples.sentence: Groundwater levels are falling alarmingly in parts of the North China Plain.
Alarmingly, nearly a third of the water never reaches the crops.

collocations.example: Salt levels in the soil are alarmingly high. 土壤含盐量高得令人担忧。
The water table has dropped alarmingly since 1980. 自1980年以来地下水位下降得惊人。
The desert is spreading alarmingly fast. 沙漠扩张得快得惊人。
The flood came alarmingly close to the village. 洪水离村子近得吓人。
This year's drought is alarmingly similar to that of 1997. 今年的旱情与1997年那次惊人地相似。

collocations.translation: 令人担忧的是…（评注整句）
collocations.example: Alarmingly, the river ran dry for several weeks. 令人担忧的是，这条河断流了好几周。

collocations.translation: 以惊人的速度（此处必须用形容词 alarming，不能写 alarmingly）
collocations.example: Groundwater is disappearing at an alarming rate. 地下水正以惊人的速度消失。

wordForms.noun: alarm（警报；惊慌；闹钟）
wordForms.verb: alarm（使惊慌，使担忧）：The figures alarmed the whole village.
wordForms.adjective: alarming（令人担忧的，用于事物）/ alarmed（感到惊慌的，用于人）
wordForms.other: -ing/-ed 形容词辨析：an alarming figure（令人担忧的数字）vs be alarmed at the figure（对该数字感到担忧）。alarmingly 有两种身份：程度副词（alarmingly high）与句子副词（Alarmingly, ...）；名词短语固定为 at an alarming rate。

classPractice.question: The number of bees in the region has fallen ____ (alarm) over the past ten years.
classPractice.note: 空格修饰动词 has fallen，须用副词 alarmingly；alarming 是形容词，只能修饰名词。

classPractice.question: 这一带的地下水位正以惊人的速度下降。（两种表达各写一句）
classPractice.answer: The water table here is falling alarmingly. / The water table here is falling at an alarming rate.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词用副词 alarmingly；改用名词短语则须写 at an alarming rate（形容词 alarming + rate），不能说 at an alarmingly rate。

translation: adj. 预定的，预期的（发生、到达）；到期的，应支付的；【due to】由于，因为  adv.（方位）正…（如 due north 正北）  n.（复数 dues）会费
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: expected or arranged to happen at a particular time; owed and needing to be paid; (due to) caused by or because of.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 应得的，应有的（常用于 give sb their due、one's due share 等）
uncommonMeanings.example: Each village received its due share of the water.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 适当的，充分的（多见于 in due course、with due care and attention 等固定表达）
uncommonMeanings.example: Drive with due care on the muddy track beside the canal.

posExamples.sentence: The next release of water from the reservoir is due on Friday.
The decline in yields was due to poor soil rather than bad weather.
The main canal runs almost due east for twenty kilometres.

collocations.translation: 由于，因为（后接名词或动名词）
collocations.example: Crop losses this spring were due to a shortage of water. 今春减产是由于缺水。
The new sensors are due to be installed next month. 新传感器预定下月安装。

collocations.translation: 预定在（某时间）到来、发生
collocations.example: The heavy rains are due in July. 大雨预计七月到来。
That field is due for watering tomorrow. 那块地明天该浇水了。

collocations.translation: 到适当的时候，在适当时机
collocations.example: The full results will be published in due course. 全部结果将在适当的时候公布。

collocations.translation: 恕我直言（客气地表示不同意）
collocations.example: With all due respect, these figures cannot be right. 恕我直言，这些数字不可能对。
The old irrigation ditch runs due north. 那条老水渠正北向延伸。
To give the old method its due, it needed no electricity. 平心而论，老办法一度电也不用。

wordForms.noun: dues（会费）；one's due（应得之物）
wordForms.adjective: due（预定的；到期的；应得的）
wordForms.adverb: duly（适时地；按规定地；理应地）：The pump was duly repaired.
wordForms.other: 用法提醒：due to 传统上作表语（The delay was due to rain），现在也广泛作状语，与 owing to / because of 意思相同；because of 最口语，owing to 更正式。英音 due /djuː/ 与 dew（露水）同音，拼写勿混（美音两词多读 /duː/）。

classPractice.question: The sharp fall in the water table is ____ to years of over-pumping rather than to the drought.
classPractice.note: be due to sth 表原因，“由于”；此处 to 是介词，后接名词短语 years of over-pumping。

classPractice.question: 第一批传感器预定于下周一安装。The first batch of sensors ____ ____ ____ be installed next Monday.
classPractice.note: be due to do sth 表“预定做某事”；主语中心词 batch 为单数，用 is；传感器是被安装，故不定式用被动 be installed。

translation: n. 意识，认识，知晓；（对某问题的）关注，重视
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: knowledge or understanding that something exists or is important; also the ability to notice what is happening around you.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对周围环境的）觉察力，警觉，感知能力
uncommonMeanings.example: Tiredness dulls a driver's awareness of the road.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （医学语境）神志，清醒的知觉
uncommonMeanings.example: The patient showed no awareness of her surroundings for hours after the operation.

posExamples.sentence: Public awareness of water shortages has grown since the river ran dry.
Sensors give farmers a real-time awareness of what each field needs.

collocations.example: The campaign raised awareness of water waste in the countryside. 这场活动提高了农村地区对浪费水的认识。
Public awareness of soil damage is still low. 公众对土壤退化的认识仍然不足。

collocations.translation: 环保意识（关于什么方面的意识）
collocations.example: Environmental awareness grew quickly after the floods. 洪水之后环保意识迅速增强。

collocations.translation: 意识到…（that 引导同位语从句）
collocations.example: There is a growing awareness that water is not free. 人们越来越意识到水并非免费。
A lack of awareness led to serious over-watering. 认识不足导致了严重的过量浇灌。
Self-awareness matters as much as book knowledge. 自知之明与书本知识同样重要。

collocations.translation: 宣传活动／宣传周（旨在提高认识）
collocations.example: The school ran a water-saving awareness campaign in May. 学校五月办了一次节水宣传活动。
They dug the new well with full awareness of the risks. 他们在充分了解风险的情况下打了这口新井。

wordForms.noun: awareness（意识，认识）
wordForms.adjective: aware（意识到的）/ unaware（未意识到的）：be aware of sth；be aware that ...
wordForms.adverb: unawares（出其不意地，冷不防）：The storm caught them unawares.
wordForms.other: 句法提醒：aware 通常只作表语，不直接作定语（不说 an aware farmer，可说 an environmentally aware farmer 或 a self-aware person）。awareness 一般不可数、前不加 a，但被 growing、new 等修饰时可用 a（a growing awareness that ...）。

classPractice.question: Precision farming has raised farmers' ____ (aware) of how much water each field really needs.
classPractice.note: 形容词 aware 加 -ness 变抽象名词 awareness，在此作 raised 的宾语，前有名词所有格 farmers'。

classPractice.question: 这些讲座提高了公众对黄河缺水问题的认识。（raise）
classPractice.answer: The lectures have raised public awareness of the water shortage in the Yellow River basin.
classPractice.note: raise awareness of sth 为固定搭配；awareness 此处不可数，前不加 a。

translation: v. 威胁，恐吓；危及，对…构成威胁
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to say you will harm sb, or to be likely to harm or damage sth

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （书面/文学色彩）（天气、险情等）预示…将至；（无生命主语）很可能带来（坏结果）
uncommonMeanings.example: Dark clouds threatened rain before the wheat was safely stored. 麦子还没入仓，乌云就预示要下雨了。

posExamples.sentence: Sandstorms and drought threaten the wheat fields along the Yellow River.
The gang threatened the farmers who refused to sell their land.
If nothing is done, rising salt levels threaten to ruin this soil.

collocations.translation: 扬言要做某事；很可能发生（坏事）
collocations.example: The river threatens to burst its banks in July. 这条河七月有可能决堤。
They threatened the workers with dismissal. 他们以解雇威胁工人。
The oasis is threatened by the advancing desert. 这片绿洲受到沙漠推进的威胁。
Overuse of water threatens the survival of the whole valley. 过度用水危及整个河谷的生存。

collocations.translation: 扬言诉诸法律（正式/新闻用语）
collocations.example: The village threatened legal action against the factory. 村里扬言要起诉那家工厂。
Bees are now a threatened species in many farming areas. 蜜蜂如今在许多农业区是受威胁物种。

collocations.translation: 对…构成威胁（名词 threat 的高频搭配）
collocations.example: Chemical run-off poses a threat to the river. 化学径流对这条河构成威胁。

wordForms.noun: threat 威胁，恐吓；构成威胁的人或事
wordForms.verb: threaten 威胁；危及（规则变化 threaten-threatened-threatened）
wordForms.adjective: threatening 威胁的，恶狠狠的；（天色）阴沉欲雨的 / threatened 受到威胁的，濒危的
wordForms.other: 发音陷阱：threaten /ˈθretn/ 里 ea 读短音 /e/，不读 /iː/。名词是 threat（没有 -en），高频结构 pose a threat to sth。表"扬言要做"只能用 threaten to do sth，不说 threaten doing ✗。

classPractice.question: Rising sea levels are ______ (threat) the fertile farmland of the Nile Delta.
classPractice.note: are 后缺现在分词构成进行时；名词 threat → 动词 threaten → threatening。

classPractice.question: 沿岸的村庄每年夏天都受到洪水的威胁。The villages along the river ______ ______ ______ floods every summer.
classPractice.note: be threatened by sth = 受…威胁；主语 villages 是复数，用 are。

translation: v. 承认（属实、存在）；公认，认可；感谢，致谢
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to admit that sth is true or exists, or to show that you have noticed or received sth

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式，公文/商务）告知收到（信件、报告、款项等）
uncommonMeanings.example: Please acknowledge receipt of the soil report. 请告知已收到这份土壤报告。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （日常）用点头、招手等向某人致意，表示看见了对方
uncommonMeanings.example: He hurried past without acknowledging his neighbour. 他匆匆走过，没跟邻居打招呼。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式，书刊/论文）鸣谢，声明感谢
uncommonMeanings.example: The book acknowledges the farmers who shared their records. 书中对提供记录的农民表示了鸣谢。

posExamples.sentence: Officials finally acknowledged that too much river water had been taken.
The Nile is acknowledged as the lifeline of Egyptian agriculture.
She acknowledged making a mistake when setting the irrigation timer.

collocations.example: The government acknowledged that the river was over-used. 政府承认这条河被过度取水了。
He acknowledged taking more water than the rules allowed. 他承认取水超过了规定。
Drip irrigation is widely acknowledged as the most water-saving method. 滴灌被公认为最节水的灌溉方式。
Both sides acknowledged the need for stricter water rules. 双方都承认有必要制定更严的用水规定。
The office acknowledged receipt of our application. 办公室告知已收到我们的申请。

collocations.translation: 人们普遍认为…（书面论述常用）
collocations.example: It is generally acknowledged that ancient farmers watched the floods closely. 人们普遍认为古代农民密切观察洪水。

collocations.translation: 肯定、感谢某人的贡献或付出
collocations.example: The head teacher acknowledged the students' hard work in her speech. 校长在讲话中肯定了学生们的努力。

wordForms.noun: acknowledgement（英式）/ acknowledgment（美式）承认；致谢；（收到的）回执
wordForms.verb: acknowledge 承认；认可；答谢；告知收到（规则变化，去 e 加 -ed：acknowledged）
wordForms.adjective: acknowledged 公认的（an acknowledged expert 公认的专家）
wordForms.other: 拼写：ac-know-ledge，中间藏着 know，词尾是 -ledge（同 knowledge）。句型提醒：主动式后接 that 从句或 doing（acknowledge having done），不接 to do ✗；被动式可用 be acknowledged as / to be。

classPractice.question: The Yellow River is widely ______ (acknowledge) as the cradle of Chinese farming.
classPractice.note: is ... as 结构需过去分词构成被动；be acknowledged as = 被公认为。

classPractice.question: 他承认在灌溉上浪费了大量的水。He ______ ______ a great deal of water in irrigation.
classPractice.note: acknowledge 后接动名词表已发生的事（acknowledge doing sth），不能用 to waste ✗。

translation: v. 称…的重量；重量为…；仔细考虑，权衡
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to measure how heavy sb/sth is, to have a certain weight, or to consider sth carefully

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使忧虑，沉重地压在心头（weigh on sb / on sb's mind）
uncommonMeanings.example: The long drought weighed on the old farmer's mind. 长久的干旱一直压在老农心头。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （航海术语）起锚，启航（weigh anchor）
uncommonMeanings.example: The ship weighed anchor at sunrise. 轮船在日出时起锚。

posExamples.sentence: Workers weigh every truck of grain before it enters the store.
The committee weighed the plan carefully before approving it.
The smallest sensor weighs no more than a hen's egg.

collocations.translation: 权衡，掂量（各种因素）（英式常用）
collocations.example: Let's weigh up the options before digging the canal. 挖渠之前我们先权衡各种方案。
The village weighed the pros and cons of drip irrigation. 全村权衡了滴灌的利弊。
You must weigh the cost against the water you save. 你必须把成本与省下的水量放在一起权衡。

collocations.translation: 就某事发表意见，参与讨论（较口语，新闻中常见）
collocations.example: Several scientists weighed in on the irrigation debate. 几位科学家就灌溉之争发表了看法。
She weighed out one kilo of seeds for each plot. 她给每块地称出一公斤种子。
A full sack of grain weighs about fifty kilos. 一满袋粮食重约五十公斤。
He weighed his words before answering the reporter. 回答记者前他斟酌了措辞。

wordForms.noun: weight 重量；砝码；负担；分量（carry weight 有分量）
wordForms.verb: weigh 称重；重量为；权衡（规则变化 weigh-weighed-weighed）/ outweigh 在重要性上超过
wordForms.adjective: weighty 沉重的；重大的 / weightless 失重的 / overweight 超重的
wordForms.other: 不规则拼读：-eigh 读 /eɪ/（weigh, eight, neighbour）。动词 weigh 无 t，名词 weight 有 t，别写成 weight the pros and cons ✗。表"重量为"时不用被动、不用进行时：It weighs 5 kilos.（✗ It is weighed 5 kilos.）

classPractice.question: 用 weigh / weight 填空：Before buying the system, the village had to ______ the cost against the water it would save.
classPractice.note: had to 后跟动词原形，此处需动词 weigh（权衡）；weight 是名词，不能作谓语。

classPractice.question: Each of the new soil sensors ______ (weigh) less than 200 grams.
classPractice.note: Each of + 复数名词作主语视为单数，谓语用第三人称单数；weigh 表"重量为"时不用被动。

translation: v. 起源，发源，来自；首创，创造
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to begin to exist or appear for the first time in a place or situation; to create sth new

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （尤美式，交通用语）（列车、航班、线路等）始发于
uncommonMeanings.example: The train originates in Lanzhou and follows the river east. 这趟列车从兰州始发，沿河向东行驶。

posExamples.sentence: Wheat farming originated in the valleys of the Yellow River.
The word 'canal' originates from a Latin term for a pipe.
The scientist who originated this method never patented it.

collocations.example: Many crops we eat originate from the Middle East. 我们吃的许多作物源自中东。
Rice growing originated in southern China. 水稻种植起源于中国南方。

collocations.translation: 由某人首创，出自某人之手
collocations.example: The plan to reuse waste water originated with a young engineer. 循环利用废水的方案由一位年轻工程师首创。
The festival originated as a prayer for rain. 这个节日最初是一场祈雨仪式。

collocations.phrase: be believed/thought to have originated in...
collocations.translation: 据信起源于…（指过去用完成不定式）
collocations.example: The wheel is believed to have originated in Mesopotamia. 车轮据信起源于美索不达米亚。

collocations.translation: 首创某种方法/想法（及物用法）
collocations.example: He originated a simple way of testing soil moisture. 他首创了一种检测土壤湿度的简易方法。

collocations.translation: 原产于…的…（现在分词作后置定语）
collocations.example: Potatoes are crops originating in South America. 马铃薯是原产于南美洲的作物。

wordForms.noun: origin 起源；出身（常用复数 origins）/ originality 独创性 / originator 首创者
wordForms.verb: originate 起源；首创（规则变化，去 e 加 -ed：originated）
wordForms.adjective: original 最初的；原创的；原版的
wordForms.other: 表"起源于"时 originate 是不及物动词，只说 originate in / from / with，绝不能写成 be originated from ✗；只有"首创某物"这一及物用法才可用被动。

classPractice.question: The custom of sharing river water ______ (origin) in ancient Egypt.
classPractice.note: origin(n.) → originate(v.)；讲远古已发生的事用一般过去时；originate in + 地点，不用被动。

classPractice.question: 滴灌起源于以色列，如今在世界各地使用。Drip irrigation ______ ______ Israel and is now used all over the world.
classPractice.note: originate in + 地点表"起源于"，是不及物动词，不能说 was originated in ✗。

translation: n. 程度；限度；范围，面积，大小
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: how large, serious or important sth is; the limit or size of sth

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （书面）一大片（土地、水域）；广袤的区域
uncommonMeanings.example: A vast extent of desert lies west of the irrigated fields. 灌溉农田以西是一大片沙漠。

posExamples.sentence: To a certain extent, everyone in the valley is to blame for the dry riverbed.
Satellites can now measure the exact extent of the desert.
Nobody yet knows the full extent of the damage to the crops.

collocations.example: To some extent, we all depend on the same river. 在某种程度上，我们都依赖同一条河。
Egypt's harvest depends to a large extent on the Nile. 埃及的收成在很大程度上取决于尼罗河。

collocations.translation: 到何种程度（常用于设问、写作论点）
collocations.example: To what extent can algorithms replace a farmer's experience? 算法在多大程度上能取代农民的经验？
The study measures the extent to which water is wasted. 这项研究测量水被浪费的程度。
The soil dried out to the extent that nothing would grow. 土壤干到了寸草不生的地步。
The full extent of the disaster became clear only weeks later. 灾情的全貌几周后才清楚。

collocations.phrase: assess / measure the extent of sth
collocations.translation: 评估、测定…的程度或范围
collocations.example: Engineers were sent to measure the extent of the cracks in the dam. 工程师被派去测定大坝裂缝的范围。

wordForms.noun: extent 程度，范围 / extension 延伸部分；延期；电话分机
wordForms.verb: extend 延伸；扩大；（向某人）致以
wordForms.adjective: extensive 广泛的，大量的 / extended 延长的，扩大的
wordForms.other: extent 通常不可数，短语里冠词很讲究：to some extent、to a large extent（有 a）、to what extent（无冠词）。别与动词 extend、名词 extension 混写。

classPractice.question: To some ______ (extend), algorithms now decide how much water each field gets.
classPractice.note: 介词 to 后需名词；to some extent 是固定短语，动词 extend → 名词 extent。

classPractice.question: 科学家仍在评估这次洪水造成的破坏程度。Scientists are still assessing ______ ______ ______ the flood damage.
classPractice.note: the extent of sth = …的程度/范围，extent 前须加 the，后接 of 短语。

translation: adj. 高尚的，崇高的；贵族的，出身高贵的　n. 贵族
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: having or showing fine personal qualities that people admire; belonging to a family of high social rank

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （书面）宏伟的，壮丽的（多形容建筑、景物）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old dam is a noble structure spanning the whole valley. 那座老坝是横跨整个山谷的宏伟建筑。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （化学术语）惰性的，不活泼的（noble gases 稀有气体）
uncommonMeanings.example: The noble gases hardly react with other elements. 稀有（惰性）气体几乎不与其他元素反应。

posExamples.sentence: Teaching in a remote village school is noble work.
The king gave land beside the Nile to a young noble.
She comes from a noble family that once ruled the valley.

collocations.example: Feeding the world is a noble cause. 让全世界吃饱是一项崇高的事业。

collocations.translation: 令人钦佩的努力（常含虽败犹荣之意）
collocations.example: Their attempt to green the desert was a noble effort. 他们绿化沙漠的尝试是一次可敬的努力。
He acted from noble intentions, not for money. 他出于高尚的动机行事，而不是为了钱。
The land was granted to a man of noble birth. 这片土地被授予一位出身贵族的人。

collocations.phrase: It is noble of sb to do sth
collocations.example: It was noble of her to give the invention away free. 她免费公开这项发明，非常高尚。

collocations.translation: 品格高尚（抽象名词搭配）
collocations.example: His nobility of character won the trust of the whole village. 他品格高尚，赢得了全村的信任。

wordForms.noun: nobility 贵族阶层；高尚，崇高 / noble 贵族 / nobleman 贵族（男，复数 noblemen）
wordForms.adjective: noble 高尚的；贵族的（比较级 nobler / noblest，也可用 more / most noble）
wordForms.adverb: nobly 高尚地，英勇地（noble 去 e 加 -ly，不是 nobley ✗）
wordForms.other: 最易错的形近词：noble ≠ Nobel /nəʊˈbel/（诺贝尔，人名）——诺贝尔奖是 Nobel Prize，写成 Noble Prize ✗。

classPractice.question: The old engineer acted ______ (noble), refusing any reward for his work.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 acted 需副词；形容词 noble 以"辅音字母+le"结尾，去 e 加 -ly → nobly。

classPractice.question: 用 noble / Nobel 填空：Turning deserts into farmland is a ______ cause, and the scientist behind it later won a ______ Prize.
classPractice.note: 第一空修饰 cause 用形容词 noble（崇高的）；第二空是奖项专名 Nobel Prize，不可写成 Noble Prize。

translation: v. 拥抱；欣然接受，乐于采纳（新事物、观点）　n. 拥抱
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to hold sb closely in your arms; to accept an idea, change or belief willingly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）包括，涵盖
uncommonMeanings.example: 'Precision farming' embraces sensors, drones and software. "精准农业"涵盖传感器、无人机和软件。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）信奉，皈依（某种宗教或信仰）
uncommonMeanings.example: He embraced Buddhism after travelling in the mountains. 他在山中游历后皈依了佛教。

posExamples.sentence: The whole industry has embraced digital tools in the past ten years.
The report embraces everything from soil testing to crop prices.
The two old friends parted after a long embrace.

collocations.example: Young farmers embrace change more readily than their parents. 年轻农民比父辈更愿意拥抱变化。
She embraced the opportunity to study precision farming abroad. 她抓住了出国学习精准农业的机会。
He was the first in the family to embrace the idea of farming without soil. 他是家里第一个接受无土栽培理念的人。
Drip irrigation has been widely embraced across the region. 滴灌在该地区已被广泛采用。
Good schools embrace diversity of every kind. 好学校包容各种各样的差异。
She embraced her daughter before the train left. 火车开动前她拥抱了女儿。

collocations.phrase: hold sb in a warm embrace
collocations.translation: 温暖地拥抱某人（名词用法）
collocations.example: She held her grandson in a warm embrace. 她紧紧地拥抱着孙子。

wordForms.noun: embrace 拥抱（与动词同形）
wordForms.verb: embrace 拥抱；欣然接受；涵盖（去 e 加 -ed/-ing：embraced, embracing）
wordForms.adjective: all-embracing 包罗万象的，无所不包的
wordForms.other: 构词：em-（使…进入）+ brace（源自"手臂"），字面就是"用双臂围住"。名动同形且重音都在第二音节 /ɪmˈbreɪs/。作"接受"讲时比 accept 更主动、更热情，写作中用来表达"积极拥抱新事物"。

classPractice.question: Villages along the Nile have long ______ (embrace) the idea that water must be shared.
classPractice.note: have + 过去分词构成现在完成时，与 long 连用；此处 embrace 指"欣然接受（观点）"。

classPractice.question: 并不是所有年长的农民都愿意接受这些算法。Not all older farmers are ready to ______ these algorithms.
classPractice.note: be ready to do sth 后接动词原形；用 embrace 比 accept 更能体现"主动接纳新技术"。

translation: v. 激励，鼓舞；给予灵感，启发；激起（信心、敬意等感情）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to give sb the desire, confidence or idea to do or create sth

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式，医学用语）吸气（与 expire 呼气相对）
uncommonMeanings.example: The patient was asked to inspire deeply through the nose. 医生让病人用鼻子深深吸气。

posExamples.sentence: The Nile inspired one of the world's oldest irrigation systems.
Her lecture inspired several students to study agricultural science.
The whole project was inspired by a single photograph of a dry riverbed.

collocations.example: The film inspired many students to study agriculture. 这部影片激励许多学生学习农学。
The shape of the new grain store was inspired by a beehive. 新粮仓的造型灵感来自蜂巢。
The engineer's calm manner inspired confidence in the villagers. 工程师沉着的态度让村民产生了信心。
The teacher inspired us with her own story. 老师用她自己的经历激励我们。
It was the most inspiring speech I had ever heard. 那是我听过的最鼓舞人心的演讲。
For him, the Yellow River is a constant source of inspiration. 对他来说，黄河是不竭的灵感来源。
Engineers often draw inspiration from nature. 工程师常常从自然中汲取灵感。

wordForms.noun: inspiration 灵感；鼓舞人心的人或事物
wordForms.verb: inspire 激励；启发；激起（去 e 加 -ed：inspired）
wordForms.adjective: inspiring 鼓舞人心的（描述事物）/ inspired 深受鼓舞的；才华横溢的（an inspired guess 神来之笔）/ inspirational 富有启发性的 / uninspiring 平淡无奇的
wordForms.adverb: inspiringly 鼓舞人心地（较少用）
wordForms.other: 拼写与重音同时变化：inspire /ɪnˈspaɪə(r)/ → inspiration /ˌɪnspəˈreɪʃn/（去 e、i 变 a、重音前移）。句型只有 inspire sb to do sth，没有 inspire sb that ✗。

classPractice.question: The way desert plants store water ______ (inspire) engineers to design drip irrigation.
classPractice.note: 叙述已发生的事用一般过去时；固定句型 inspire sb to do sth，不说 inspire sb doing ✗。

classPractice.question: 用 inspiring / inspired 填空：Standing on the bank of the Yellow River, the students felt deeply ______ by the ______ story of the ancient dam builders.
classPractice.note: 第一空描述人的感受用 -ed 形式 inspired（受到鼓舞的）；第二空修饰事物 story 用 -ing 形式 inspiring（鼓舞人心的）。

translation: n. 受欢迎；受欢迎的程度，人气；普及，流行
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: the state or quality of being liked, enjoyed or supported by a large number of people

posExamples.sentence: Drip irrigation has grown in popularity among farmers along the Yellow River.
The app's popularity with young farmers took the researchers by surprise.

collocations.translation: 越来越受欢迎，逐渐流行起来
collocations.example: Solar-powered pumps have gained in popularity since the subsidy started. 补贴开始后，太阳能水泵越来越受欢迎。

collocations.translation: 广受欢迎，享有很高人气
collocations.example: Nile-valley cotton once enjoyed huge popularity in Europe. 尼罗河流域的棉花曾在欧洲广受欢迎。

collocations.translation: 在（某人群）中的受欢迎程度
collocations.example: The app owes its popularity among farmers to its simple design. 这款软件在农民中受欢迎，靠的是设计简单。

collocations.phrase: at the height of its popularity
collocations.translation: 在最鼎盛、最流行的时候
collocations.example: At the height of its popularity, the water-saving scheme covered thirty counties. 该节水方案最盛行时覆盖了三十个县。
Flood irrigation has seen a sharp decline in popularity. 漫灌的流行程度大幅下降。

collocations.translation: 提升…的人气，使…更受欢迎
collocations.example: Free training boosted the popularity of the new soil sensors. 免费培训提升了新型土壤传感器的受欢迎程度。

collocations.translation: 人气比拼（不比实力比人缘，常含贬义）
collocations.example: Choosing an irrigation plan should not be a popularity contest. 选灌溉方案不该变成比谁人缘好。
The five crops are listed in order of popularity. 这五种作物按受欢迎程度排列。

wordForms.noun: popularity 受欢迎（不可数）；popularization 普及，推广
wordForms.verb: popularize（英式亦作 popularise）使普及，推广
wordForms.adjective: popular 受欢迎的；大众的、民间的（popular music 流行音乐 / the popular vote 民众选票）
wordForms.adverb: popularly 普遍地（be popularly known as… 俗称为…）
wordForms.other: 不可数名词，无复数、前面不加 a/an；说"人气上升"要说 a rise in popularity（这里的 a 修饰 rise，不是修饰 popularity）。三个形近词别混：popular 受欢迎的 / populous 人口稠密的 / populace 平民百姓。

classPractice.question: Rooftop rainwater tanks have grown in ______ (popular) in the village over the past decade.
classPractice.note: 介词 in 后要用名词；popular 加名词后缀 -ity 变 popularity，不可数，不加 -s。grow/gain in popularity = 越来越受欢迎。

classPractice.question: 这些土壤传感器在当地农民中广受欢迎。These soil sensors ______ ______ ______ among local farmers.
classPractice.note: enjoy great/huge popularity among sb = 在…中广受欢迎；popularity 不可数，不能说 a great popularity；主语 sensors 是复数，动词用原形 enjoy。

translation: vt. & vi. 递送，投递；发表（演讲），宣读；输送（水、电、养分等）；兑现（承诺），拿出成果；宣布（判决）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to take goods, letters or messages to a person or place; also to give a speech, to supply something, or to produce the result that was promised

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 接生；（婴儿）被接生下来（常用被动 be delivered）
uncommonMeanings.example: The baby was delivered by a village midwife before dawn. 婴儿是天亮前由村里的接生员接生的。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 猛击出（一拳、一脚）
uncommonMeanings.example: He delivered a heavy blow to his opponent's chin. 他朝对手的下巴猛击了一拳。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）解救，使摆脱（deliver sb from sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: They prayed to be delivered from famine and flood. 他们祈祷能摆脱饥荒与洪水。

posExamples.sentence: Pumps deliver water to each field exactly when the algorithm asks.
She delivered a short speech about saving water in the Nile valley.
The new pump looked impressive on paper, but in the field it failed to deliver.

collocations.example: A drone delivers spare parts to the pump station every Monday. 无人机每周一把备件送到泵站。

collocations.translation: 发表演讲；做讲座；作报告
collocations.example: She delivered a speech on the history of the Nile floods. 她就尼罗河洪水的历史发表了演讲。

collocations.translation: 传达消息、口信；推送提示
collocations.example: The app delivers a warning message when the soil gets too dry. 土壤过干时，这款软件会推送一条警告消息。
Officials have yet to deliver on their promise of cheaper water. 官员们降低水价的承诺至今尚未兑现。
These thin pipes deliver water and nutrients straight to the roots. 这些细管把水和养分直接输送到根部。
The court delivered its verdict on the water dispute yesterday. 法庭昨天就这起用水纠纷宣布了判决。
The engineers delivered the whole irrigation system on time. 工程师们按时交付了整套灌溉系统。

wordForms.noun: delivery 递送，投递；分娩；（演讲的）表达方式（复数 deliveries）；deliverance（正式）解救；deliverer 投递员，救助者
wordForms.adjective: deliverable 可交付的（也可作名词，指"交付成果"）
wordForms.other: 拼写只有一个 l：deliver / delivery（不是 dellivery）。deliver 可单独作不及物动词，意为"兑现期望、拿出成果"：The team didn't deliver. 名词 delivery 一词多义，在医院语境里指"分娩"，在演讲语境里指"台风、表达方式"。

classPractice.question: Farmers praised the new system for its fast ______ (deliver) of water to dry fields.
classPractice.note: its 与形容词 fast 之间要用名词，deliver 的名词形式是 delivery；此处指"输送"，不可写成 deliverance（解救）。

classPractice.question: 这家公司承诺降低水费，但至今没有兑现。The company promised to cut water bills, but it has not ______ ______ that promise yet.
classPractice.note: deliver on sth = 兑现（承诺、诺言）；not…yet 与现在完成时连用，故用 has not delivered on。

translation: n. 金额，款项；总数，和；（英式，常用复数）算术题 vt. & vi. 合计；概括，总结（多作 sum up）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: an amount of money; the total that you get when you add numbers together; (verb) to add up figures or to state the main points briefly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （法官向陪审团）作总结陈词（sum up）
uncommonMeanings.example: The judge summed up before the jury retired. 陪审团退席前，法官作了总结陈词。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一眼看穿，迅速对（某人）作出判断（sum sb up）
uncommonMeanings.example: She summed him up the moment he opened his mouth. 他一开口她就把他看透了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （the sum of…）某人全部的知识／经验，仅有的这些
uncommonMeanings.example: That is the sum of my knowledge about drip irrigation. 关于滴灌，我知道的就这些。

posExamples.sentence: A large sum of money was spent on drip irrigation last year.
The sum of these two figures is the field's daily water need.
Let me sum up the main causes of soil erosion here.

collocations.example: A large sum of money was spent on lining the canals. 一大笔钱花在给渠道做防渗衬砌上。

collocations.phrase: invest a huge sum in sth
collocations.example: They have invested a huge sum in solar-powered pumps. 他们在太阳能水泵上投入了巨资。
One sentence sums up the whole report. 一句话就概括了整篇报告。

collocations.translation: 总而言之（作插入语，置于句首）
collocations.example: To sum up, water saved is water earned. 总而言之，省下的水就是赚来的水。
The sum total of the flood losses came to two million yuan. 洪灾损失总额达到二百万元。

collocations.translation: 一次性支付的整笔款项
collocations.example: Farmers received a lump sum for giving up flood irrigation. 农民放弃漫灌可一次性领到一笔补偿款。
The children were doing sums when the bell rang. 铃响时孩子们正在做算术题。

collocations.phrase: be greater/more than the sum of its parts
collocations.example: A good research team is greater than the sum of its parts. 一个好的科研团队，力量大于成员之和。

wordForms.noun: sum 金额，总和；summary 摘要，概要（复数 summaries）；summation（正式）总结，合计
wordForms.verb: sum（sums / summed / summing，末尾 m 要双写）
wordForms.adjective: summary（adj.，正式）立即的、不经正常程序的（summary dismissal 即时解雇）；summative 总结性的
wordForms.adverb: summarily 立即地，即决地（He was summarily dismissed. 他被当场解雇。）
wordForms.other: some 的重读形式与 sum 同音 /sʌm/，听力中极易混。三兄弟别搞混：sum 总和／款项，summit 顶峰／峰会，summary 摘要。sum 表"总结"时几乎总带副词 up（sum up / sum sth up），单独用 sum 表"总结"是错的。

classPractice.question: Having ______ (sum) up the main findings, the engineer took questions from the farmers.
classPractice.note: having + 过去分词构成完成式非谓语，表示该动作先于主句发生；sum 以"单元音+单辅音"结尾且重读，加 -ed 要双写 m，写成 summed（后面的 up 不能丢）。

classPractice.question: 总而言之，算法能算出每块田到底需要多少水。______ ______ ______, algorithms can work out exactly how much water each field needs.
classPractice.note: to sum up 作独立成分置于句首，后加逗号，相当于 in short / in a word；注意动词 sum 后的 up 不能丢。

translation: vt. & vi. 延长（时间）；扩大，扩展；延伸，绵延；扩建；伸出（手、腿）；（正式）给予，提供（邀请、感谢、帮助等）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to make something longer, larger or last longer; to stretch over a distance or period; (formal) to offer something such as help, thanks or an invitation to somebody

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （规定、影响）适用于，涉及（extend to sb/sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: The ban on flood irrigation extends to all riverside villages. 禁止漫灌的规定适用于所有沿河村庄。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 竭尽全力（extend oneself，多用于否定）；满负荷运转（be fully extended）
uncommonMeanings.example: She never really extends herself in class. 她上课从没真正尽过全力。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式，金融）提供（贷款、信贷）
uncommonMeanings.example: The bank refused to extend a loan to the small farm. 银行拒绝向这家小农场提供贷款。

posExamples.sentence: They extended the canal so that three more villages could get water.
The wheat fields extend for miles along both banks of the river.
The village extended a warm welcome to the visiting water engineers.

collocations.example: The office extended the deadline for water-permit applications. 办事处延长了用水许可的申请期限。
The canal extends from the reservoir to the edge of the desert. 这条渠从水库一直延伸到沙漠边缘。
The wheat fields extend for over thirty kilometres. 麦田绵延三十多公里。
They extended the pump house to hold two more machines. 他们扩建了泵房，好再放两台机器。
The school extended an invitation to the irrigation expert. 学校向那位灌溉专家发出了邀请。
Neighbouring villages extended a helping hand during the drought. 旱灾期间，邻村伸出了援手。
The project extended the scope of the survey to three provinces. 该项目把调查范围扩大到三个省。
They extended their lead to three goals in the last minute. 他们在最后一分钟把领先优势扩大到三球。

wordForms.noun: extension 延长（部分）；扩建；电话分机；文件扩展名 | extent 程度，范围（to a large extent 在很大程度上）
wordForms.adjective: extended 延长的，扩大的（an extended family 大家庭）；extensive 广泛的，大量的
wordForms.adverb: extensively 广泛地（Drip irrigation is used extensively here.）
wordForms.other: 辨析 extend / expand：extend 是从原有基础"向外延长、延伸"（extend a deadline；The road extends to the border.）；expand 是整体"变大、膨胀"（Metal expands when heated.）。名词也别混：extent 说程度，extension 说延长出来的那一段。

classPractice.question: 用 extend / expand 的适当形式填空：① Air ______ when it is heated, so the balloon rises. ② The county plans to ______ the canal by another ten kilometres.
classPractice.note: ①说气体受热体积变大，用 expand；主语 Air 不可数视为单数，一般现在时用 expands。②说在长度上向外延长，用 extend；plan to 后接动词原形。

classPractice.question: The new pipeline, ______ (extend) deep into the desert, now supplies two hundred farms.
classPractice.note: 逗号中间是非谓语作后置定语，pipeline 与 extend 是主动关系且表持续状态，用现在分词 extending；extend into/to 表"延伸到…"。
